ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a six-membered nitrogen-containing ring, with N labeled at the bottom, a double bond drawn from the lower-right edge to the right ring carbon; the top ring carbon is connected to H and OH; the right ring carbon is connected to R and H; the upper-left ring carbon is connected to R; the lower-left ring carbon is connected through a carbon to the lower-left R. Curved arrows are also drawn in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring these arrows. Reasoning: Transcribe each R group as the wildcard atom '*'. According to the specified path, take the lower-left R as '*C', enter the adjacent lower-left ring carbon and assign the ring label as 'C1'. Along the ring through nitrogen and the lower-right double-bond carbon gives 'N=C'. Continue to the right ring carbon bearing the R branch, written as 'C(*)'. Then to the top ring carbon bearing the hydroxyl group, written as 'C(O)'. Finally pass through the upper-left ring carbon bearing an R substituent to close the ring, written as 'C1*'. Combining gives the SMILES: '*CC1N=CC(*)C(O)C1*'.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Ignore the curved arrows and transcribe only the static connectivity. Treat each R group as a wildcard atom '*'. Start from the lower-left R substituent as '*C', continue into the adjacent ring carbon as 'C1', follow the ring through 'N=C', then the right-side carbon bearing an R branch as 'C(*)', then the top carbon bearing hydroxyl as 'C(O)', then close the ring through the remaining carbon bearing the upper-left R substituent as 'C1*'. This yields '*CC1N=CC(*)C(O)C1*'.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个六元含氮环，底部标有 N，右下边到右侧环碳画有双键；顶部环碳连有 H 和 OH；右侧环碳连有 R 和 H；左上环碳连有 R；左下环碳通过一个碳连到左下的 R。图中还画有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略这些箭头。
推理：将每个 R 基团转写为通配符原子 '*'。按指定路径从左下 R 取为 '*C'，进入相邻的左下环碳并给环标号为 'C1'。沿环经过氮和右下双键碳得到 'N=C'。继续到右侧带 R 支链的环碳，写作 'C(*)'。再到顶部带羟基的环碳，写作 'C(O)'。最后经过左上带 R 取代基的环碳闭环，写作 'C1*'。合并得到 SMILES：'*CC1N=CC(*)C(O)C1*'。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct image-to-SMILES transcription is the natural single route for this task; it is distinct by using the drawn connectivity and treating all generic R labels uniformly as wildcard attachment atoms while ignoring the curved arrows.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the skeletal structure: a six-membered ring containing one N at the lower part, an N=C double bond on the lower-right side, an OH-bearing ring carbon near the top, and three R substituents attached at the upper-left, lower-left alkyl side chain, and right-side ring carbon positions. Curved arrows are present but are explicitly ignored.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that the arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply SMILES conventions for skeletal structures: unlabeled vertices are carbons, labeled N and O are heteroatoms, ring closure can be denoted with digit 1, '=' marks the N=C double bond, branches use parentheses, and each generic R attachment can be represented as wildcard '*'. Choose any valid traversal that preserves the same connectivity; one such traversal gives the standard answer.
